name: Bluesky AT Protocol
tagline: Decentralized social network API for posts, profiles, and feeds
description: Public API for the Bluesky social network built on the AT Protocol (atproto). Developers can read public posts and profiles without auth, and create posts, follow users, manage lists, and access personal data using app passwords or OAuth. Serves as the main interface for building clients, bots, and analytics tools on the Bluesky network.

auth.details: public.api.bsky.app is unauthenticated public-read only (AppView). Authenticated XRPC (createSession, writes, private data) go to the user's PDS or Bluesky entryway (bsky.social) with session JWT (app password) or OAuth; Authorization: Bearer <accessJwt>.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free to use the public API and self-host; no published paid API plans

rate_limits: Public AppView (api.bsky.app / public.api.bsky.app): generous limits, no published general numeric cap—contact Bluesky if hit. Hosted PDS (by IP): 3,000 req/5 min overall; createSession 30/5 min and 300/day per account; stricter on some writes—see docs.
use_cases: get a Bluesky profile by handle or DID
fetch a user's recent posts and thread replies
search posts or users on the public network
create a post or reply with an authenticated session
follow or unfollow an account programmatically
read a custom feed generator or timeline
